name: TextBoolean
statement: SELECT p.Name AS Name, p.Rank AS Rank FROM Views.Program AS p WHERE p.Flag = $Flag AND p.Rank < $Limit ORDER BY p.Name

name: TextNull
statement: SELECT p.Name AS Name FROM Views.Program AS p WHERE p.Amount = $Missing OR p.Name = $Name

name: Paged
statement: SELECT p.Name AS Name, p.Rank AS Rank FROM Views.Program AS p ORDER BY p.Name

name: PagedAll
statement: SELECT p.Name AS Name FROM Views.Program AS p ORDER BY p.Name DESC

name: Path
statement: SELECT p.Name AS Name, ar.Name AS AreaName FROM Views.Program AS p LEFT JOIN p/Views.Program_Asset/Views.Asset/Views.Asset_Area/Views.Area AS ar

name: InnerPath
statement: SELECT p.Name AS Name, ar.Name AS AreaName FROM Views.Program AS p INNER JOIN p/Views.Program_Asset/Views.Asset/Views.Asset_Area/Views.Area AS ar

name: Preserved
statement: SELECT p.Name AS Name FROM Views.Program AS p WHERE p.Rank = $Rank

name: EnumParameter
statement: SELECT p.Name AS Name FROM Views.Program AS p WHERE p.Status = $Status

name: Count
statement: SELECT p.Name AS Name FROM Views.Program AS p WHERE p.Rank >= $Rank

name: CountAmount
statement: SELECT p.Name AS Name FROM Views.Program AS p
